description:
From the parking lot the trail leads westwards, with stops at twelve numbered markers,
correlating to the descriptions in the attached guide.
This trail is maintained by the Wolverine Nordic & Mountain Society.

Wolverine Nordic & Mountain Society

Photos and Maps courtesy of the WNMS.
directions: Drive 30km North of Tumbler Ridge on the Heritage Hwy or 88km South from Dawson Creek, look for the Trailhead and Parking Area adjacnet to the Hwy.
title: Murray Canyon Overlook Trail
